title: Additional Experiments for Doctoral Thesis
summary: A collection of Python scripts evaluating synthetic tabular healthcare datasets (breast, liver, lung cancer) generated via CTGAN, computing privacy and fidelity metrics across real vs. synthetic tables. The scripts import SDV's SingleTableMetadata to describe table schemas and call sdmetrics' DCRBaselineProtection and QualityReport functions to run the actual evaluation.
